name: vTensor capability register
statement: vTensor's registered capability IDs (VT-01 onward): a GGML device backend whose only tensor-compute substrate is Verdant Tensor, matching the GGML CPU oracle byte for byte, so any GGML application can run a Verdant Prism generator deterministically (REQ-PRISM-GENERATION, REQ-ENGINE-FIDELITY).
